## Generate PM Work Orders

The generator. Reads each Maintenance Plan's `nextDueAt` (via the SAME math the plan's own computeds and the Maintenance Calendar use), and for every plan whose `generateOn` has arrived within `horizonDays`, mints one Work Order — UNLESS a work order already exists for that (plan, due day) pair, checked via `planDueKey`. Re-running this command with the same inputs creates nothing new: the only thing that makes a new work order is a new due day.

The checklist is copied onto the work order as fresh, unanswered items — results never flow back to the plan's template.

### Non-goals

No scheduler — this command runs on invocation (Maintenance Home's "Generate now", or after a meter reading crosses a threshold), never on a timer; no platform capability for that exists.
